en: Black-and-white rural scene showing two men working in a hay field in the foreground, one in work clothes with a scythe and the other in darker, more formal clothing. Behind them stretches a patchwork of cultivated fields leading to a compact village with white and light-colored houses. At the center of the village stands a prominent church with a tall, slender spire. Low rolling hills form the distant background. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.
